Before: orange juice ~250ml (~110 kcal), strawberries ~100g (32), Greek yogurt cup ~170g (~150 kcal), 2 fried eggs ~100g (~180 kcal), mushrooms sautéed ~100g (~80 kcal), 2 slices toast ~60g (~170 kcal). Plus a butter/spread portion; some appears left in the tub, so maybe half was used (~35 kcal).

After: juice mostly gone (a little left), strawberries gone, the yogurt cup appears to still hold a lot (looks nearly full), eggs, mushrooms and toast gone, spread partly used.

Eaten: juice ~230g (100 kcal), strawberries 100g (32), eggs 100g (180), mushrooms 100g (80), toast 60g (170), spread ~5g (35). Yogurt is likely mostly uneaten, so assume ~30g eaten (~25 kcal).

Total ≈ 622 kcal, mass ≈ 625 g.
